item.title: TokenBpe: A Hand-Rolled C++20 Tokenizer Where 240 MB/s Comes From a Dozen Multiplied Micro-Tricks
item.description: Unica2804/Token_BPE is a 0-star personal repo: a hand-written C++20 BPE tokenizer reporting 240 MB/s encode throughput. I pulled the whole source and checked the mechanics claim by claim, then ran a single-threaded control on my 2-core box. Full post and discussion live on the BBS.
